name: Vlad Harrowvale
original_name: ヴラド・ヘローヴェイル
source:
[i]"No matter how hard you try and resist, your fate has already been sealed."[/i]

[b]Race:[/b] Vampire / King of Nyx
[b]Interest:[/b] Games
[b]Weapon:[/b] Magic

King of Nyx, and ruler of all vampires. Also known as the "Rebel King."

He was not originally of royal blood, but seized the throne thanks to his overwhelming magical abilities, and reigns over the Nyx as the most fearsome vampire of all time.

He is arrogant and vicious, with no other vampire capable of standing up to him.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=vlad]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
